release: CoreSpirit v62 — programmable visual coordinate system over the converged v1 runtime
runtime_baseline: v61 converged v1 runtime: reactive VM + scene graph + deterministic replay
focus: high-level plot placement over semantic chart/panel areas
renderer-neutral visual coordinate spaces: time, bar, price, percentage, screen, normalized
semantic visual ranges, visibility and area clipping intent
point-based line, box and polygon geometry
structured custom visual payloads with coordinate placement
same-coordinate-space validation for deterministic host transforms
persistent scene-graph preservation of placement and geometry
architecture_invariants: plot is a convenience API over the same programmable visual scene contract
visual placement is semantic data: area, coordinate space, visibility, range and clipping intent
one visual object uses one coordinate-space interpretation; mixed-space line/box/polygon geometry is invalid
geometry and placement survive into the renderer-neutral scene graph
legacy time/price visual fields remain compatibility projections rather than a competing semantic model
screen/normalized coordinates are resolved by hosts and never expose renderer handles to the VM
custom visuals carry structured payload data, not executable renderer code
visual state remains transactional and rollback-safe under the v1 runtime
visual placement has no risk, policy, order or broker authority
